data:
Decision: NO-GO. Win probability: 1.9%.

Top probability drivers: (1) Very low expected technical score (36.5/100) is the dominant drag; even before pricing, we are projected to miss the 70-mark technical threshold. (2) Limited response time (240 hrs) reduces our ability to evidence compliance and assemble mandatory administrative/technical deliverables. (3) Compliance coverage is only 20.7% (2 pass, 8 partial, 19 gaps), indicating high disqualification risk despite a small positive model effect.

Mandatory gaps and what closing them takes: Provide proof of Tier-1 modules (≥21% efficiency, 25-year linear warranty), Tier-1 string inverters and mounting structures via OEM authorizations/datasheets; deliver SCADA remote monitoring architecture and central dashboard design; commit to DISCO net-metering liaison and approvals plan with named resources; submit 3-year O&M with performance guarantees; arrange 2% bid security bank guarantee (scheduled bank) and ensure all mandatory submission/packaging requirements are met.

Recommendation: Do not bid unless we can raise compliance to >90% and credibly lift technical score above 70 within the available timeframe.
